_comment: Checked-in fleet-coverage manifest: the (app x backend x hardware) differential-test cells the project EXPECTS to be exercised on real hardware. The everyday gate (ctest -L omp) gives NO signal on the GPU backends -- off-fleet the CUDA/Vulkan diff tests GTEST_SKIP and skip-exit-0, so a never-run cell looks identical to a pass. The run-on-*.sh scripts emit a machine-greppable 'BT-CELL <app> <backend> <hardware> <RAN|SKIP|FAIL>' marker per binary (see scripts/run-on-*.sh) into a coverage log; scripts/check_fleet_coverage.py diffs that log against this manifest so a silently-absent or skipped cell FAILS instead of reading as covered. OMP runs everywhere and is the reference oracle, so OMP cells are not tracked here. See docs/reports-for-human/code-review-2026-06-18.md finding #8.

hardware.jetson: NVIDIA Jetson Orin Nano -- the only CUDA execution target (PC is build-only).
hardware.minipc: rocky-ryzen Radeon 780M iGPU -- Vulkan (kiss-vk hard-selects eIntegratedGpu).
hardware.samsung: Samsung Galaxy S24 (subgroup 32) -- Vulkan, serial R5CY21Y3VEV.
